patterns.label: chatbot pleasantry
patterns.regex: \b(certainly!|great question|i hope this helps|happy to help|absolutely!)
patterns.tip: Delete it. It's a reply to a prompt, not part of the writing.

patterns.label: offer to do more
patterns.regex: \b(would you like me to|let me know if you|feel free to (reach out|ask)|if you'd like, i can)
patterns.tip: Delete it. End when the content ends.

patterns.label: AI self-reference
patterns.regex: \b(as an ai\b|as a (large )?language model|as of my (last )?(knowledge|training) (update|cutoff))
patterns.tip: Delete it. It's left over from the chat.

patterns.label: placeholder
patterns.tip: Fill it in with the real name, date or link, or remove the line.

patterns.label: tool artifact
patterns.tip: Remove it. It's a citation or tracking leftover from the AI tool.

patterns.label: manufactured drama
patterns.regex: (here's the (thing|deal|kicker|catch)|here's why (that|this|it) matters|the result\?|hot take:|and honestly\?|let that sink in|read that again|that's the real \w+|then i realized:)
patterns.tip: Cut the setup and just say the point. Usually a plain "But" works.

patterns.label: stock opener
patterns.regex: \b(in today's (fast-paced|ever-changing|digital|rapidly)|in the (dynamic|ever-evolving|fast-paced) (world|landscape|realm) of|as the world continues to|in an era (where|of)|in the realm of)
patterns.tip: Start with your actual claim, problem or scene.

patterns.label: cliche
patterns.regex: \b(shouting into the void|no fluff|game[- ]changer|move the needle|at the end of the day|a deep dive|unlock(ing)? the (power|potential|secrets?)|look no further|double-edged sword|to new heights|will never be the same|redefin(e|es|ing) (the|your|how)|(your|full) potential|more than just a|has never been more|the key lies in|a pressing (concern|issue)|warrants? careful consideration|unprecedented (opportunities|access|levels?))
patterns.tip: Say the specific thing the cliché is standing in for.

patterns.label: email boilerplate
patterns.regex: \b(i hope (this|my) (email|message|note) finds you well|i wanted to (reach out|touch base|provide a quick update)|(forward-thinking|innovative) companies like yours|support your journey|was truly impressed)
patterns.tip: Open with the reason you're writing.

patterns.label: whether-you're framing
patterns.tip: Pick the reader you're actually writing for.

patterns.label: both-sides seesaw
patterns.tip: Take a position, or say plainly what's uncertain.

patterns.label: rule of three
patterns.tip: Keep a list of three only if all three matter. Two is fine.

patterns.label: inflated significance
patterns.regex: \b((stands|serves) as a (testament|reminder|beacon)|is a testament to|(plays?|played) a (crucial|pivotal|vital|key|significant) role|a (pivotal|crucial|key) (moment|turning point)|underscores? (its|the) (importance|significance)|setting the stage for|indelible mark|left an? (lasting|enduring) (legacy|impact))
patterns.tip: Replace it with what actually happened, and let the reader judge the importance.

patterns.label: shaping the conversation
patterns.tip: Name who changed their mind, or what changed.

patterns.label: weasel attribution
patterns.tip: Name the source, or cut the claim.

patterns.label: challenges-and-legacy formula
patterns.tip: Name the specific problem with a fact, or cut the paragraph.

patterns.label: superficial -ing tail
patterns.tip: End the sentence before the "-ing" clause, or make it a real claim with a source.

patterns.label: vague connection
patterns.tip: Say what the actual relationship is.

patterns.label: hedging disclaimer
patterns.regex: \b(it('s| is) (important|worth|crucial) (to note|noting|to remember)|while specific details are limited|based on (the )?available information|not widely documented|not publicly available|maintains a low profile)
patterns.tip: Cut "it's important to note" and just note it.

patterns.label: corrective framing
patterns.regex: \b(should not be confused with|does not (by itself )?establish|rather than (simply|merely|just))
patterns.tip: Drop the straw man unless someone actually believes it.

patterns.label: copula avoidance
patterns.tip: Use "is" or "has".

patterns.label: negative parallelism
patterns.tip: Skip the "not X" part and say Y directly.

patterns.label: AI vocabulary (2023-24)
patterns.tip: Use a plainer word, or keep it if it's the literal meaning.

patterns.label: AI vocabulary (2024-25)
patterns.tip: Use a plainer word: "show", "help", "improve", "use".

patterns.label: AI vocabulary (2026)
patterns.tip: Fine once. A cluster of these reads as AI.

patterns.label: promotional tone
patterns.tip: Swap the adjective for a fact you can check.

patterns.label: stiff synonym
patterns.tip: Use the everyday word: "use", "start", "help", "people".

patterns.label: transition stack
patterns.tip: Use a logical connector ("because", "so", "but") or none.

patterns.label: summary closer
patterns.tip: Cut the recap. Stop when you're done.

patterns.label: emoji bullet/heading
patterns.tip: Drop the emoji, or turn the bullets back into prose.

patterns.label: inline bold label
patterns.tip: Turn "**Label:** text" bullets back into sentences.
